L8.13_dream_real_model.run_to_run_note: temperature 0 is not bit-stable here: two runs of the same prompt and checks gave yield 0.500 and 0.594 (prompt-cache reuse changes the numerics). Invented quotes after verification and trap items accepted were 0 in every run with the new checks.
L8.13_dream_real_model.yield_limit: at most 8 items per chunk, and a 1,200-token chunk leaves about 500 answer tokens (2,048 context), so a full 8-item answer is cut off and the chunk is read again in halves: 1-2 extra passes per day here. The fixture days hold 9-13 facts per chunk, more than real days are likely to.
L8.13_dream_real_model.chunks_means: model calls, including an answer cut off at its token limit (read again in halves): the final run's 8 are 6 answered chunks and 2 cut-off answers; prompt_tokens and completion_tokens count the answered calls only

L8.3_recall_floors.decision: floors unchanged. False recalls already do not exceed words alone (unrelated 0 and 1 against 3 and 3; personal 4 and 3 against 4 and 5). No setting in the 1,080-point grid lifts MIXED hit@1 above 24/30 within those limits; the nearest alternative (COSINE_FLOOR_PARTIAL 0.50) gains 1 on HARD but loses 2 on HELD_OUT.
L8.3_recall_floors.why_no_gain: the misses that floors could reach overlap the false recalls: true shared-word matches score 0.29-0.41 (wifi code 0.407, flower 0.382, mother 0.384, spare key 0.357, rubbish night 0.294) while unrelated shared-word matches score 0.27-0.53 (bees 0.449, black hole 0.423, car registration 0.427, favourite season 0.427); meaning-only paraphrases at 0.21-0.24 sit among personal false recalls at 0.20-0.26. The rest are ranking misses or blink-8M placing the pair far apart (football team vs Sydney Swans 0.016).
